  PROBLEM: ISSUE_TITLE is interpolated directly into jq filter strings instead of being passed via --arg, so titles with quotes/backslashes can make the query invalid and the fallback will silently mask the failure.
  WHY: Several reviewers noted the current smoke-test title is controlled so this is latent today, but the unsafe pattern is reused across helper queries and one path already uses the safer --arg form.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:588-671 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: ISSUE_TITLE is not validated before use, so an empty or missing title turns the jq filters into a blank comparison or no-op and the poller loses the run.
  WHY: If create-issue fails or the helper is reused outside the smoke-test path, the workflow can silently return empty/unknown results and eventually fail with the labels-missing error.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:726-729 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The OTHER_ACTIVE_PLAN_RUNS fallback uses raw gh api with 2>/dev/null instead of gh_api_safe, so a rate-limited call is treated as zero active runs.
  WHY: If that secondary request fails exactly when a spurious completed run is observed, the workflow can incorrectly exit with plan_failed even though the real run is still active.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: Lines ~628 and ~667 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The shell variable `ISSUE_TITLE` is spliced directly into a jq double-quoted string literal via bash expansion.
  WHY: If the title ever contained a literal double-quote or backslash, the jq expression would become syntactically invalid, and the query would silently return empty or `"unknown"` via the fallback.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: Line ~726 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `gh api` call in the `OTHER_ACTIVE_PLAN_RUNS` path uses raw `gh api` with `2>/dev/null` rather than `gh_api_safe`, so it lacks rate-limit backoff.
  WHY: If the GitHub API is rate-limited when the spurious-completed-run path fires, this call fails silently and `OTHER_ACTIVE_PLAN_RUNS` is computed as 0, causing the poller to exit with `plan_failed`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: Line 628 (capture_run_id function), Line 668 (PLAN_RUN_STATUS query) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: ISSUE_TITLE is interpolated directly into jq filter strings using `"${ISSUE_TITLE}"` instead of using the safer `--arg` parameter pattern.
  WHY: If ISSUE_TITLE contains characters like `"` or `\` that break jq string literal syntax, the filter will fail with a jq parse error and the fallback then silently suppresses the error.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: Lines 588-597 (wait-plan env), Lines 618-634 (capture_run_id) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No defensive handling for the case where ISSUE_TITLE output is empty or malformed.
  WHY: If ISSUE_TITLE is empty/unset, the jq filter `select(.display_title == "")` would match runs with empty display titles rather than correctly detecting the missing-title error condition.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: capture_run_id() body (~line 628 in diff) and PLAN_RUN_STATUS query (~line 668 in diff) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: ISSUE_TITLE is interpolated directly into the jq --jq filter string (`select(.display_title == "${ISSUE_TITLE}")`), while the OTHER_ACTIVE_PLAN_RUNS query on the same page (~line 729) correctly uses the `--arg title "${ISSUE_TITLE}"` pattern.
  WHY: If ISSUE_TITLE ever contains double-quotes or backslashes, the inline interpolation would produce a malformed jq expression and the `|| echo ""` fallback would silently swallow the parse error.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: capture_run_id() body (~line 628 in diff), PLAN_RUN_STATUS query (~line 668 in diff) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: No guard against empty or unset ISSUE_TITLE.
  WHY: With an empty ISSUE_TITLE, both capture_run_id and PLAN_RUN_STATUS silently return empty/"unknown" results and the wait-plan poll loop eventually times out.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: capture_run_id() retry loop (~lines 628-634 in diff) and PLAN_RUN_STATUS inner poll (~lines 664-668 in diff) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Both queries use `|| echo ""` / `|| echo "unknown"` to suppress jq failures, so a persistent jq parse error is retried as if it were a transient empty result.
  WHY: A malformed title burns through the retry loop without changing the input, wasting the polling window before the downstream logic fails with `plan_failed`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: capture_run_id() ~lines 615-640 (especially the new jq filter at ~628) and the PLAN_RUN_STATUS query ~lines 656-671 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `capture_run_id` helper (and the two new queries) now unconditionally depend on `ISSUE_TITLE` being set and non-empty, but it is only exported from the `create-issue` step in the smoke-test path.
  WHY: Other callers of this helper will either have an unset variable or an empty string, which can match the wrong run or no run and lead to the exact "Plan workflow completed but issue lacks expected labels" failure.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: ~lines 628, 668, ~730 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `ISSUE_TITLE` is interpolated directly into the jq filter string via bash `${ISSUE_TITLE}` rather than passed safely via `--arg title "${ISSUE_TITLE}"`.
  WHY: Any smoke-test title containing a double-quote, backslash, or other jq-special character produces a malformed jq expression, the fallback suppresses the error, and the wait-plan logic fails to capture the run ID or status.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
